reason: H0 continues to exercise the changed WebP decoder through the base.image_decoder protocol. Fuzzed source bytes control the newly supported VP8X header, dimensions, flags, chunk types, chunk lengths, ordering, and VP8/VP8L selection. fuzz_image_decoder calls decode_image_config, obtains workbuf_len, allocates the work buffer, and then calls decode_frame_config and decode_frame, so it reaches the new VP8X state machine and its delegation to the inner VP8 decoder. The new vp8.QUIRK_WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT state is also populated by decoder.do_decode_image_config_limited_vp8x? from input-controlled VP8X dimensions; no separate harness configuration is necessary to reach that behavior. The changes therefore do not create a material entry-point, protocol, state, configuration, input-semantics, or attack-surface gap.
evidence: fuzz constructs wuffs_webp__decoder and passes its wuffs_base__image_decoder upcast to fuzz_image_decoder.
fuzz_image_decoder invokes decode_image_config, workbuf_len, decode_frame_config, decode_frame, and frame_dirty_rect.
decoder.do_decode_image_config_limited? now selects variant 0x04 for an input chunk type of 'VP8X'.
decoder.do_decode_image_config_limited_vp8x? derives width, height, and vp8x_header_flags from args.src and calls vp8.set_quirk! with vp8.QUIRK_WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT.
decoder.do_decode_frame? consumes input-controlled ICCP, ANIM, ANMF, ALPH, VP8, VP8L, XMP, and EXIF chunks and enforces their new ordering and length rules.
decoder.workbuf_len exposes the new VP8X allocation requirements through the same method already used by fuzz_image_decoder.
recommended_action: Keep H0 unchanged; add corpus seeds for VP8X and mixed chunk sequences if coverage data later shows poor discovery, but no harness maintenance is required by this commit.
